name: M1 — Management dashboard "Cost & AI" must render the shared MetricsDashboard
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Task origin:** Parent document M1 required refactoring the Cost & AI section of the Management Dashboard to embed the shared `MetricsDashboard.vue` component instead of the inline KPI strip, chart toggles, per-model table and budget bars.
2. **Verification performed:** I read both target files (`ManagementDashboardView.vue`, `useManagementDashboard.js`) in the working tree before editing — the requested changes had already landed on disk from M1.
3. **No edits emitted:** Re-emitting identical files would be review noise, so I produced zero `<file_change>` blocks and delivered a line-level verification report instead.
4. **Verified state:** `MetricsDashboard` is wired into a full-bleed `<main>` slot, `sectionReady('cost')` returns `true`, and all five cost computeds (`costChart`, `costByProject`, `costByModel`, `costByPerson`, `budgetByProject`) plus `projectsForPersonName`, `seriesOptions`, `toggleSeries` are gone with zero residual references; `spendBars` and `data.cost` loader are intentionally kept.
5. **Remaining gates:** Only the user-side actions remain — run `npm run build` (expect green), then a visual demo confirming single header/scrollbar, Pulse KPI + trend card navigation, and untouched `MetricsDashboard.vue`; one harmless dead `series` object in the cost filter was flagged but left alone per the minimal-diff constraint.

Replace the inline Cost & AI UI in the management dashboard with the existing analytics dashboard component, and delete the duplicated code. No changes to the analytics component itself. CONTEXT - The product already ships a full cost/AI dashboard: `src/components/analytics/MetricsDashboard.vue` (already registered as the `analytics` app in `src/config/appComponentsMap.js` / `src/config/apps.js`). It has its own header, date presets, grouping (minute/hour/day), admin view toggles, per-model / per-user / per-project breakdowns and the pricing editor (`PriceEditor.vue`, `DailyChart.vue`). - `src/components/analytics/index.vue` was already deleted by the user — do not reference it. - The management dashboard re-implemented the same screen inline: `src/views/ManagementDashboardView.vue`, section branch `v-else-if="d.state.section === 'cost'"` ("Cost & AI"), plus `seriesOptions` + `toggleSeries()` and the cost computeds in `src/views/management/useManagementDashboard.js`. REQUIRED CHANGES 1) `src/views/ManagementDashboardView.vue` - Import the component: `import MetricsDashboard from '@/components/analytics/MetricsDashboard.vue'` - Replace the WHOLE `
…
` block with: `
` - Make the `
` element full-bleed for the cost section so the embedded dashboard is not double-padded / double-scrolled: `:class="d.state.section === 'cost' ? 'flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden p-0' : 'flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto p-3 md:p-4'"` - In the `sectionReady` computed, `case 'cost': return true` (the embedded component owns its own loading state). - Delete the now unused `const seriesOptions = [...]` array and the `function toggleSeries(id) { … }` function. - KEEP `spendBars` (the Pulse "AI spend trend" card still uses it). 2) `src/views/management/useManagementDashboard.js` - Remove the cost computeds that only the deleted template used: `costChart`, `costByProject`, `costByModel`, `costByPerson`, and `budgetByProject` (verify each is unreferenced first — check `projectsForPersonName` too). - Remove their entries from the returned object. - KEEP the `cost` LOADER, `data.cost`, `fmtCoins`, `fmtNum`, `bounds`, `rangeLabel` — the Pulse KPIs read `d.data.cost` (`total.total_cxjcoins`, `budget.pct`). CONSTRAINTS - Do NOT modify `src/components/analytics/MetricsDashboard.vue`, `DailyChart.vue` or `PriceEditor.vue`. It is Options API and depends on the global `$storex` / `$project` mixin — it must stay as is. - Do NOT change the analytics registration in `appComponentsMap.js` / `apps.js`. - Do not rename the `cost` section id, its label ("Cost & AI") or its `fa-solid fa-coins` icon — the left rail, Pulse KPIs and the assistant suggestions link to `d.setSection('cost')`. - Keep diffs minimal: no reformatting of untouched code. ACCEPTANCE - `npm run build` completes with no errors and no "unused variable" lint noise for the removed symbols. - Opening the management dashboard → Cost & AI shows the analytics dashboard with real data: totals, daily chart, per-model table, per-user/per-project breakdowns (admin), grouping selector, date presets, pricing editor reachable. - Only ONE header ("Analytics Dashboard") above the content and only one scrollbar inside the section. - Pulse "AI spend" KPI and the "AI spend trend" card still render values and still navigate to the cost section.
